question: True or false: when hundreds of adults followed one identical 20-week endurance programme, some barely improved their aerobic fitness?
answer: True. In the HERITAGE Family Study, gains in maximal oxygen uptake ranged from almost nothing to more than a litre a minute under the same supervised training. Relatives responded alike: about half of the spread in response ran in families. One plan, followed to the letter, built very different bodies.
move: An average result hides people for whom the plan barely works.
ask: Have I given up on something because it did not work for me as fast as it did for others?
trap: Assuming the same training gives everyone roughly the same gains.
source: Bouchard et al., J Appl Physiol, 1999
reference: Bouchard et al., Familial aggregation of VO2max response to exercise training: results from the HERITAGE Family Study, Journal of Applied Physiology, 1999
